title: Tornadoes Result in Guard Support With Heavy Equipment
description: B-roll of the Arkansas National Guard supporting the local community with heavy equipment conducting route clearance after a wave of tornadoes struck Arkansas late night on April 25, resulting in 190 Airmen and Soldiers' activation to assist civil authorities with a variety of missions in the Garland County community. Produced by Spc. Chauncey Reed.
keywords: tornado, Arkansas National Guard, Chauncey Reed, Garland County, arktornado11, route clearance
unit_name: Arkansas National Guard Public Affairs Office
